scale: Each criterion decomposes into published capability checks. Each check is scored 0 (absent), 1 (partial or assisted), or 2 (fully supported), from documented, observable product behavior. Criterion score = points earned / points possible × 10. Dimension score = dimension points earned / dimension points possible × 100. Composite = weighted sum of dimension scores.

dimensions.name: Candidate matching & screening
dimensions.definition: The core job of an AI recruiting tool: finding the right candidates for a role and evaluating them accurately against its requirements.

criteria.name: Structured criteria evaluation
criteria.definition: Evaluates against explicit role-specific criteria with per-candidate reasoning, beyond keyword/Boolean relevance.

checks.name: Role requirements captured as explicit, structured criteria (not only a Boolean string)
Written per-candidate reasoning against the role's criteria
Per-criterion verdicts (pass/fail or graded), not only an overall relevance rank
Cites the profile evidence behind each judgment
Criteria editable mid-role with candidates re-evaluated

criteria.name: Learning from feedback
criteria.definition: Adapts its matching per role from recruiter/hiring-manager feedback.

checks.name: Structured calibration round on early candidates
Learning persists per role, not only per search session
Existing pipeline re-scored when criteria change

criteria.name: Hard requirements
criteria.definition: Supports mandatory criteria that are never relaxed (certifications, clearances, locations).

checks.name: Mandatory criteria that ranking never relaxes

criteria.name: Trajectory & context inference
criteria.definition: Reads career trajectory, company caliber, and inferred attributes rather than title/keyword matches.

checks.name: Models career progression and tenure patterns
Uses company caliber/stage context in matching

dimensions.name: Workflow automation
dimensions.definition: How much of the recruiting workflow the tool runs on its own — search, screening, outreach, and scheduling — versus assisting a recruiter who drives each step.

criteria.name: Automated search
criteria.definition: Initiates and continuously runs candidate searches from a role brief without per-search recruiter operation.

checks.name: Starts sourcing from a role brief without manual query building
Continuously monitors for new candidates entering the market
Expands/refreshes the pool automatically as the role evolves

criteria.name: Automated screening
criteria.definition: Evaluates candidates against role criteria and produces decisions with reasoning, rather than only ranking results for manual review.

checks.name: Produces screening decisions without per-candidate review
Screens the full sourced pool, not a sample
Flags uncertain cases for human review

criteria.name: Automated outreach
criteria.definition: Composes and sends personalized outreach and follow-ups without per-message recruiter action.

checks.name: Sends without per-message approval (approval mode optional)
Automation spans more than one channel

criteria.name: Scheduling automation
criteria.definition: Handles candidate replies through to a booked interview (Q&A, availability, calendar booking).

dimensions.name: Outreach & engagement
dimensions.definition: Ability to convert sourced profiles into responsive candidates.

criteria.name: Personalization
criteria.definition: Per-candidate AI personalization grounded in the candidate's actual background.

checks.name: Personalization grounded in the candidate's actual background
Message tailored to the role's specific pitch

criteria.name: Sequencing
criteria.definition: Multi-step sequences, scheduling windows, and testing.

criteria.name: Reply handling
criteria.definition: Automated handling of candidate questions and replies.

checks.name: Replies detected and classified (interested / not / question)
Clean handoff to the recruiter with conversation context

dimensions.name: Talent pool coverage & data
dimensions.definition: Breadth of candidate discovery and quality of contact data.

criteria.name: Source breadth
criteria.definition: Discovery beyond a single network: open web, GitHub, publications, licensed partners.

checks.name: Open-web profiles beyond a single network
Index scale (hundreds of millions of profiles)
Rediscovery of candidates already in the ATS/CRM
Continuous re-enrichment of stale contact data

dimensions.name: Integrations & reporting
dimensions.definition: Fit into the surrounding recruiting stack, and visibility into pipeline performance.

criteria.name: ATS integrations
criteria.definition: Breadth and depth of ATS/CRM sync.

checks.name: Duplicate detection against existing ATS records
